split_policy.primary_axis: generated provenance role before replay directory, generator label, report output, or fixture basename
split_policy.positive_rule: generated inventory rows never define positive parser, sema, lowering, IR, runtime, or e2e behavior; they may only point at canonical fixture truth owned elsewhere
split_policy.canonical_truth_rule: canonical behavior truth remains in tests/native and behavior owner indexes, not generated artifacts
split_policy.report_only_rule: generated reports, replay packets, manifest entries, generator paths, and validation outputs are provenance-only until canonical behavior owners claim support
split_policy.retired_surface_rule: old-mode, shim, fallback, compatibility, unsupported, alternate acceptance, report-only, generated-output-only, and generator-output-only claims are strict rejection, canonical rejection, or provenance-only evidence
